behavior_coverage.detail: All 21 behaviors from spec.md are covered by at least one test function

test_case_coverage.detail: All 20 test cases from spec.md are exactly matched with correct inputs and expected outputs

all_pass_on_correct_engine.detail: Executor (fullstack1) reports 22/22 tests pass on the correct engine. Verifier cannot independently run tests per permission boundary. All assertions appear logically sound upon code review.

branch_coverage.detail: Executor claims 98% branch coverage (>80% required). Test coverage is thorough: overflow covers input/result/boundary branches; evaluate covers Num/Constant/BinOp/UnaryOp/invalid branches; chaining covers divide-by-zero and coercion. Two uncovered lines reportedly Python <3.8 compat code unreachable on 3.11.

mutant_detection.detail: Cannot verify mutation detection through static code review alone. The test suite's thorough coverage of error paths, boundary conditions, and edge cases (overflow boundary at 2^53, evaluate UnaryOp/bad operator/syntax errors, chain divide-by-zero, batch invalid op, undo on empty history, thread safety with assertions) suggests strong mutant-killing capability. Runtime verification against the 10 mutant engines is required for definitive assessment.

strengths: 21/21 behaviors covered, 20/20 test cases exactly matched
Overflow test covers input overflow, boundary (2^53 exact), AND result overflow — three distinct branches
evaluate tests cover UnaryOp (negation), unsupported operators (**), syntax errors, and division-by-zero in expressions
Chaining tests cover coercion, happy path, and divide-by-zero
Thread safety test asserts both no-exceptions AND correct results (==2.0)
Error path tests consistently verify exc_info.value.code, not just exception type
Edge cases: empty batch, undo on empty history, sqrt(0), memory recall initial=0.0
observations: Chain operations (via _Chain) do not record to calculator history — by design, as _Chain methods bypass _record(). This is consistent with engine implementation.
Undo only removes history entries without restoring calculator state (e.g., memory). This matches the spec requirement of removing history entries.
test_reset verifies memory=0.0 and history=[], but _chain_value clearing is untestable externally (private attribute).
